name: AttractionCapacityTimedEntryManager
tagline: Timed-entry capacity, gate admissions and walk-in sales in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete visitor-operations app for museums, aquariums, observation decks, science centres and theme parks: capacity dashboard with slot heatmap, slot board with drag-and-drop and closures, gate console with admissions, partial entry and walk-in sales, 7-day capacity planner and bookings with bulk actions – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Capacity per experience and entry slot
Maximum occupancy from admissions and dwell time
Closures by date, weekday and time plus on-the-day slot closures
Drag-and-drop and keyboard moves with rule checks
Gate: scan/search, partial admission, payment before entry
Walk-in sale into the next slot with places
Ticket types, experience surcharges, free member/comp tickets
Bulk pay, admit, exit, no-show, cancel, export
